svg.text: Headless Agentic AI OS — for an EBC Program Team
Architecture + two production workflows: Briefing Documents · Custom Customer Content

g.text: Pre-loaded with skills, memory, and connectors. Team runs workflows, not prompts.
Plugins distribute the harness to field teams, partners, and regional EBCs.
Every skill run, every subagent call, every cost — logged, surfaced to the Director's weekly review and the Chief of Staff's evening reconciliation.

svg.text: WORKFLOW 2 — CUSTOM CUSTOMER CONTENT (DEMOS, ONE-PAGERS, CO-BRANDED ASSETS)
every workflow run is also a memory write. Every skill miss is a skill upgrade. Year over year, first-draft quality climbs while operator hours stay flat.
